def countSubstrings(s):
    def expandAroundCenter(left, right):
        count = 0
        while left >= 0 and right < len(s) and s[left] == s[right]:
            count += 1
            left -= 1
            right += 1
        return count

    total_count = 0

        # Odd length palindromes
        total_count += expandAroundCenter(i, i)
        # Even length palindromes
